statement: The proportion of mothers reporting pregnancy weight gain differs between PRAMS Phase 8 Analytic Research File and Standard Section II.
rationale: This design can be carried out using the provided data sources as they enable a direct comparison between PRAMS_P8_ARF and PRAMS_P8_STD2 on recording pregnancy weight gain related to SUID risk factors.
prior_art: None in the inputs. The manuscript claims do not address discrepancies between PRAMS Phase 8 ARF and Standard Section II, leaving this question open for investigation.
cannot_establish: incidence rates or risk ratios since it does not have a denominator source; can only compare proportions among cases.
